description: This Java file contains JUnit test cases for the 'Command' class in the 'org.eclipse.hono.client' package. It verifies the behavior of 'Command' object creation from 'Message' objects, focusing on reply-to address parsing, validity checks, and encoding/decoding reply-to options. The tests cover various scenarios including message with/without device IDs, legacy endpoint usage, missing properties, and application properties.

classes.name: CommandTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for verifying the behavior of the 'Command' class, covering message parsing, validity, reply-to address handling, and encoding options.

methods.name: testFromMessageSucceeds
methods.description: Tests creation of Command from a valid message with reply-to address containing device ID; verifies parsing and properties.

methods.name: testForReplyToWithoutDeviceId
methods.description: Tests creation of Command from a reply-to address without device ID, expecting specific replyToId and address format.

methods.name: testForReplyToWithDeviceId
methods.description: Tests creation when reply-to address includes device ID, expecting replyToId prefixed accordingly.

methods.name: testForReplyToWithLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Tests creation with reply-to address using legacy endpoint, expecting appropriate endpoint property.

methods.name: testFromMessageSucceedsWithoutReplyTo
methods.description: Tests creation when message has no reply-to property, expecting command to be valid and one-way.

methods.name: testFromMessageSucceedsWithoutReplyToAndCorrelationId
methods.description: Tests creation with no reply-to and no correlationId, command remains valid and one-way.

methods.name: testFromMessageSucceedsWithMessageIdButNoCorrelationId
methods.description: Tests message with messageId but no correlationId, ensuring command captures messageId as correlation.

methods.name: testFromMessageSucceedsWithApplicationProperties
methods.description: Tests extraction of application properties from message, such as deviceId and tenantId.

methods.name: testFromMessageSucceedsWithNoApplicationProperties
methods.description: Ensures command creation succeeds when application properties are absent.

methods.name: testFromMessageFailsForMissingCorrelationOrMessageId
methods.description: Verifies command creation fails if neither correlationId nor messageId are present.

methods.name: testFromMessageFailsForMalformedReplyToAddress
methods.description: Checks failure when reply-to address does not match expected format.

methods.name: testFromMessageFailsForNonMatchingReplyToAddress
methods.description: Checks failure when reply-to address does not correspond to target device.

methods.name: testGetInvalidCommandReason
methods.description: Verifies that invalid commands return a reason string containing missing fields.

methods.name: testEncodeDecodeReplyToOptions
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of reply-to options flags, ensuring correct boolean interpretation.
